help.title: Help Center
help.text: Answers about booking, payments, VR and your trips, with real people when you need them.

help.aiText: Get instant answers about destinations, seasons and planning.
help.waMessage: Hello TravelMateVR, I need some help.

booking.title: Booking
booking.q1: How do I book a stay or experience?
booking.a1: Open a listing, choose your dates and guests, add any extras and follow the steps. You'll see the full price, including taxes and fees, before you pay.
booking.q2: What's the difference between instant booking and request to book?
booking.a2: Instant bookings are confirmed straight away. With a request, the partner checks availability first and you're not charged until they confirm.
booking.q3: Where do I find my booking confirmation?
booking.a3: In Bookings and in your Trip Control Center. Each booking has an ID, a receipt and a QR code that also open offline.

payment.title: Payments
payment.q1: Which payment methods can I use?
payment.a1: In Tanzania you can pay with M-Pesa, Airtel Money, Mixx by Yas, HaloPesa, or a Visa or Mastercard card from any bank. Prices are shown in US dollars, with an indicative amount in shillings for mobile money.
payment.a2: For eligible bookings you can pay a deposit now and the balance later from your booking page.
payment.a3: No. The total you see includes taxes, the TravelMateVR service fee and any conservation contribution.

cancel.title: Cancellations & refunds
cancel.q1: How do I cancel a booking?
cancel.a1: Open the booking and choose Cancel booking. You'll see exactly how much will be refunded before you confirm.
cancel.q2: How much will I get back?
cancel.a2: It depends on the cancellation policy shown on the listing: flexible, moderate or strict.
cancel.a3: Refunds go to your original payment method, usually within 5–10 business days depending on your provider.

vr.title: 360° & VR
vr.q1: Do I need a VR headset?
vr.a1: No. Every experience works on a phone or computer. A headset adds full immersion in WebXR browsers such as the Meta Quest Browser.
vr.q2: What's the difference between 360° and panoramic preview?
vr.a2: 360° experiences are full spherical captures. Panoramic previews pan across a wide photo until we capture the place in 360°.
vr.q3: The viewer is slow. What can I do?
vr.a3: 360° images are large. Try a stronger connection; once loaded, recently viewed experiences are kept for offline use.

ai.title: AI TravelMate
ai.q1: How does AI TravelMate plan trips?
ai.a1: It uses your request and saved preferences to match destinations, stays and activities from our catalogue, and explains why it chose them.
ai.a2: No. They're estimates. The exact price is shown when you book each item.
ai.q3: Can I change an AI plan?
ai.a3: Yes. Ask for changes in the chat, or save the plan and edit it day by day in the itinerary builder.

account.title: Account & privacy
account.a1: You can explore, plan and book as a guest. An account keeps your trips and bookings across devices.
account.a2: Only to provide your bookings and, if you agree, personalise recommendations. We never sell personal data.
account.q3: How do I delete my data?
account.a3: Go to My TravelMate › Privacy & security to download or erase your data.

partners.title: Partners
partners.q1: Who are the partners on TravelMateVR?
partners.a1: Local operators, lodges, guides and community businesses. Founding partners and verified partners are labelled on their listings.
partners.a2: Sample listings are fictional businesses that show how the marketplace works while partners are being onboarded.
partners.a3: Visit For Partners to apply. Our team reviews every application before listings go live.

safety.title: Safety
safety.q1: Where do I find emergency information?
safety.a1: Every destination page and your Trip Control Center show local emergency numbers and practical safety advice.
safety.q2: Can I reach TravelMateVR during my trip?
safety.a2: Yes, by WhatsApp, phone or email. Open a support request and mention your booking ID.
safety.q3: Are entry requirements up to date?
safety.a3: We review them regularly, but rules change. Always confirm with official government sources before you travel.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.text: Our team in Mbeya, Tanzania, is here to help with bookings, trips and partnerships.
